name: magnesium phosphate dibasic
purpose: Mag Phos 6X...... muscle cramps, nerve pain, spasms
uses: Helps temporarily relieve: stabbing nerve sensations; muscle contractions, spasms, and twitching; hiccups; menstrual cramps; headaches; and toothaches.
otcwarn: Keep out of reach of children. If pregnant or breastfeeding, ask a health professional before use. Stop use and ask a doctor if symptoms persist or worsen. If you have severe symptoms, consult a doctor before use.
